title: Grilled Chicken Filipino-Style Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make grilled chicken recipe inspired by Filipino cuisine, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. This dish is a great way to enjoy the smoky flavor of grilled chicken with a tangy and sweet glaze.
instructions: Thread chicken onto bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together fish sauce, ginger, brown sugar, and soy sauce.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the chicken.
Season with black pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Brush with vegetable oil during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
